\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-20↗ ex:real-projective-plane-elliptic-geometry

Show that single elliptic geometry (Example 5) satisfies Hilbert's incidence postulates and the elliptic parallel postulate if points are defined as elements of $\mathbb {R}P^2$ and lines are defined as images of maximal geodesics. \end{exercise}
